info.title: Managing jobs and services within a shield

abstract.para: This section explains how to manage jobs and services within the shielded environment, showing you how to assign both persistent &systemd; services and ad-hoc tasks to the dedicated workload.slice. Additionally, it covers how to safely unshield processes and return them to standard system CPUs when dedicated resources are no longer required.

section.title: Assigning services and tasks to the shielded slice
section.para: To execute workloads within the CPU shield, assign &systemd; service units or transient scopes to workload.slice.

step.para: Create a drop-in configuration file for your service to assign it to workload.slice.
Restart the service unit to apply the new slice configuration.
To run an ad-hoc command inside the shield, execute it within a transient scope using systemd-run.

section.title: Unshielding processes
